deficiencies.description: The rewrite converts the lecturer's deictic pointing words ('the tumor is here', 'This is the outer surface') into a specific spatial description ('lies next to the outer surface of the uterus') that the spoken text does not state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The text uses 'circumspect', an apparent malapropism or transcription error for the standard pathological descriptor 'circumscribed'. Using 'circumscribed' in the rewrite reflects the intended scientific meaning without misleading the student.

considerations.sourcePassage: This is normally a very thin muscle wall that is present in the uterus.
considerations.reason: The rewrite retains this assertion as 'which normally has a very thin muscle wall', faithfully reflecting what the lecturer stated.
